title: MITE FirstPersonModel
description: Renders player body in first person mode.
body:
It renders player model in first person, good for realism.
Also adds third person eating animation and hand swing on using throwable items.
Also renders armor on hud hands.
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00f09c46f563c6d2f0fba146059c510f9838a749.png)

Also it has some render customization, for example player can be rendered without model hands but with hud hands.
